sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:47812
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9211 of 2023

Applicant :- Mohammad Salauddin Khan @ Kartikeya
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Dr. Pooja Singh,Anshuman Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Dr. Pooja Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rakesh Kumar Singh, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
47 of 2023, under Section 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Chowk, District Lucknow.

4. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 25.02.2023 against one Kartikeya, stating that he had duped Rs. 15,00,000/- from the informant on the pretext of getting her son admitted to a medical course.
5. During investigation, it came to light that the person who had projected himself as Kartikeya was in fact the applicant.

sentences.text:
In Para 11 of the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, the applicant's involvement in C.R. No 11210056222927/2022 under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 114 I.P.C and Section 66(d) of the Information Technology Act, P.S Dindoli, District- Gujarat, in which the applicant has been granted bail by the Court of Additional Sessions Judge, Surat by means of an order dated 04.05.2023.
7.

A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant, annexing therewith a copy of the additional statement of the informant wherein she stated that the applicant's brother has repaid Rs. 15 lakh by transferring the amount in her bank account on 10.03.2023 and she does not want any further proceedings in the matter.
8.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of the bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Keeping in view the aforesaid fact and without making any observations which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail.
10. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023/Preeti.
